title.en: A swap-symmetric assignment singles out no role
title.zh: 互换对称之指派不单挑一角

statement.en: Exchanging two roles keeps no predicate that holds of exactly one of them, while each of the two single assignments holds of exactly one: an assignment singling out one of two roles is not kept by their exchange.
statement.zh: 两角色之互换不保持任何恰对其一成立之谓词，而两种单一指派各恰对一者成立：单挑两角色之一的指派，不为其互换所保持。

laws.en: A predicate on two roles, read as the two Boolean values, that holds of each role exactly where it holds of the other does not hold of exactly one of them; the assignment to the first role and the assignment to the second each hold of exactly one, so each fits a task needing exactly one.
laws.zh: 两角色读作两个布尔值；对每一角色成立恰当其对另一角色成立之谓词，不恰对其中一者成立；指派给第一角色与指派给第二角色，各恰对一者成立，故各合一项恰需一者之任务。

hypotheses.en: Empty axiom reports for the cited declarations; the module imports Lean's Std and stands off the spine.
hypotheses.zh: 所引声明之公理报告皆空；模块引入 Lean 之 Std，不在脊柱上。

hypotheses.en: Two roles, read as the two Boolean values; that the assignment is kept by the exchange, and that the task needs exactly one role, are supplied.
hypotheses.zh: 两角色读作两个布尔值；指派为互换所保持、任务恰需一角，皆为所给。

does_not_show.en: Whether an asymmetry or a procedure singling out one role is right, or which role ought to contribute.
does_not_show.zh: 打破对称、单挑一角之不对称或程序是否为对，或哪一角应当出力。

does_not_show.en: That actual parties are exactly symmetric: a real asymmetry in undertaking or control fails the premise.
does_not_show.zh: 实际之各方恰好对称：承担或控制上之真实不对称即不满足此前提。

does_not_show.en: More than two roles, or symmetries other than the exchange of the two.
does_not_show.zh: 多于两角，或两者互换以外之对称。

next_delta.en: The obstruction on the spine for any finite set of roles under a group of exchanges acting on it transitively, as an instance of the obstruction for codes.
next_delta.zh: 于脊柱上，对任一有限角色集及在其上可迁地作用之互换群陈述此阻碍，作为代码之阻碍之一例。

correspondence.en: Social choice: the anonymity and neutrality conditions of May (1952), under which a rule treating voters alike and the two alternatives alike picks neither where the votes are evenly split; read by the AI, the focal points of Schelling (1960) and the correlation devices of Aumann (1974) are the asymmetries that coordination on one of two symmetric roles needs.
correspondence.zh: 社会选择：May（1952）之匿名与中立条件下，对投票者与两选项皆一视同仁之规则，在票数相等处不择其一；依 AI 之读，Schelling（1960）之焦点与 Aumann（1974）之相关装置，正是在两对称角色中协调于其一所需之不对称。

aliases: A swap-symmetric assignment singles out no role
互换对称之指派不单挑一角

detail.en: From a start symmetric under an exchange of formations and a renaming of forms, a law keeping both never brings the formations it exchanges to agree at a sense where the renaming moves every form (SharedCodes.never_agrees_of_both); here the same obstruction for two roles.
detail.zh: 自对交换形成与更名形式皆对称之起点，保持二者之律，在更名移动每一形式之义上，永不使其所交换之形成一致（SharedCodes.never_agrees_of_both）；此处为两角色之同一阻碍。

detail.en: Imposing a code brings agreement by privileging forms, which breaks the renaming symmetry.
detail.zh: 强加代码以偏重形式而致一致，即打破更名之对称。

detail.en: The other result of the module PracticalPriorityIdentification.
